file_description: Oil Field Production - Monthly field-level oil production data
data_format: LONG format - multiple rows per field-month, one per concept

concept_descriptions.primary_production_m3: Primary recovery - production driven by natural reservoir pressure (solution gas drive, water drive, gravity drainage). No artificial pressure maintenance.
concept_descriptions.secondary_production_m3: Secondary recovery - production from pressure maintenance via waterflooding or gas injection. Maintains reservoir pressure to continue production.
concept_descriptions.tertiary_eor_production_m3: Tertiary/Enhanced Oil Recovery (EOR) - advanced recovery methods including thermal (steam), chemical (polymer, surfactant), and miscible gas (CO2, N2) flooding.
concept_descriptions.unconventional_production_m3: Unconventional oil production - tight oil and shale oil from low-permeability formations requiring hydraulic fracturing and horizontal drilling.
concept_descriptions.water_production_m3: Formation water co-produced with oil - must be separated and disposed or re-injected. High water production reduces oil production efficiency.
concept_descriptions.water_injection_m3: Water injected into reservoir for pressure maintenance (waterflooding) or disposal of produced water into approved formations.
concept_descriptions.condensate_production_m3: Liquid hydrocarbons (C5+) condensed from gas production - valuable light oil product, typically 45-60° API gravity.
concept_descriptions.stabilized_gasoline_production_m3: Natural gasoline/naphtha extracted from gas processing - light hydrocarbons (C3-C5) used as petrochemical feedstock or blending component.
concept_descriptions.field_fuel_consumption_m3: Oil consumed within the field for power generation, heating, or equipment fuel - not sold as product.
concept_descriptions.oil_density_avg_ton_per_m3: Average oil density in metric tons per cubic meter - used to calculate API gravity. Typical range: 0.8-1.0 ton/m3. Formula: API = (141.5 / density) - 131.5

unit_notes.m3: Cubic meters - Argentina standard volume unit for oil
unit_notes.ton_per_m3: Metric tons per cubic meter - density unit for API calculation
unit_notes.conversion_to_opgee: Oil: m3 to barrels (bbl) multiply by 6.28981
